headline: Expiry‑day trades are costing you a lot.

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: Expiry‑day trades cost you ₹1,16,891 across 90 trades, resulting in a loss of ₹1,16,891 and an average loss per trade of ₹1,299, with a win rate of 29% and an average return of a 28% loss. The remaining 124 trades showed a loss of ₹449 on average, a 5% loss overall, and a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying the rule to limit expiry‑day trades in the next review period.
